mapper.select: SELECT id FROM aid_media_execution_admission_guard WHERE id=1 AND ready=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM aid_media_execution_admission_guard WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aid_media_execution_permit (token,task_id,user_id,user_bucket,model_code,provider_id,state,execution_mode,owner_id, lease_until,create_time,update_time) SELECT SUBSTRING(SHA2(CONCAT('media-execution-legacy:',t.id),256),1,32),t.id,t.user_id, CONCAT('media:concurrent:user:',COALESCE(CAST(t.user_id AS CHAR),'anonymous')), COALESCE(NULLIF(t.model_name,''),'none'),m.provider_id,'ACTIVE','LEGACY','legacy', NULL,NOW(3),NOW(3) FROM aid_media_task t LEFT JOIN aid_ai_model m ON m.model_code=t.model_name WHERE t.execution_permit_token IS NULL AND t.status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING','WAIT_POLL','WAIT_CALLBACK') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aid_media_execution_permit p WHERE p.active_task_id=t.id)
mapper.update: UPDATE aid_media_task t JOIN aid_media_execution_permit p ON p.active_task_id=t.id SET t.execution_permit_token=p.token WHERE t.execution_permit_token IS NULL AND p.execution_mode='LEGACY' AND t.status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING','WAIT_POLL','WAIT_CALLBACK')
UPDATE aid_media_execution_admission_guard SET ready=1 WHERE id=1
mapper.sql: UPDATE aid_media_execution_permit p JOIN aid_media_task t ON t.id=p.task_id AND t.execution_permit_token=p.token SET p.state='ACTIVE',p.execution_mode='ASYNC',p.lease_until=NULL, p.release_reason=NULL,p.released_at=NULL,p.update_time=NOW(3) WHERE t.status IN ('PENDING','WAIT_POLL','WAIT_CALLBACK','PROCESSING') AND t.provider_task_id IS NOT NULL AND t.provider_task_id != '' AND p.execution_mode IN ('SYNC_TEXT','SYNC_IMAGE','SYNC_AUDIO','SUBMITTING') AND (p.state='ACTIVE' OR (p.state='RELEASED' AND p.release_reason IN ('LOCAL_EXECUTION_LEASE_EXPIRED','LOCAL_TEXT_CONNECTION_CLOSED','LOCAL_SYNC_CONNECTION_CLOSED')))
mapper.update: UPDATE aid_media_execution_permit SET state='RELEASED', release_reason='LOCAL_EXECUTION_LEASE_EXPIRED', released_at=NOW(3), update_time=NOW(3) WHERE state IN ('RESERVED','ACTIVE') AND execution_mode IN ('RESERVED','SYNC_TEXT','SYNC_IMAGE','SYNC_AUDIO','SUBMITTING') AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT p.token FROM aid_media_execution_permit p JOIN aid_media_task t ON t.id=p.task_id WHERE p.state IN ('RESERVED','ACTIVE') AND t.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') ORDER BY p.create_time,p.token LIMIT 200

SELECT COUNT(*) global_active, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN user_bucket=#{userBucket} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) user_active, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN model_code=#{modelCode} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) model_active, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN provider_id=#{providerId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) provider_active, COALESCE(SUM(uncertain),0) global_uncertain, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN user_bucket=#{userBucket} THEN uncertain ELSE 0 END),0) user_uncertain, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN model_code=#{modelCode} THEN uncertain ELSE 0 END),0) model_uncertain, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN provider_id=#{providerId} THEN uncertain ELSE 0 END),0) provider_uncertain, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aid_media_task own_task JOIN aid_media_submission_reconciliation own_reconciliation ON own_reconciliation.task_id=own_task.id AND own_reconciliation.del_flag='0' JOIN aid_media_submission_evidence own_evidence ON own_evidence.id=own_reconciliation.last_evidence_id AND own_evidence.task_id=own_task.id AND own_evidence.reconciliation_id=own_reconciliation.id AND own_evidence.del_flag='0' WHERE own_task.id IN #{taskId} AND own_task.status='PENDING' AND own_reconciliation.status IN ('PENDING','CLAIMED','UNSUPPORTED') AND own_evidence.verdict IN ('UNKNOWN','UNSUPPORTED') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM aid_media_execution_permit own_live WHERE own_live.task_id=own_task.id AND own_live.token=own_task.execution_permit_token AND own_live.state='ACTIVE' AND own_live.execution_mode IN ('SYNC_TEXT','SYNC_IMAGE','SYNC_AUDIO','SUBMITTING') AND own_live.lease_until IS NOT NULL AND own_live.lease_until > NOW(3))) own_uncertain FROM ( SELECT p.task_id,p.user_bucket,p.model_code,p.provider_id, CASE WHEN p.state='ACTIVE' AND t.status='PENDING' AND NOT (p.execution_mode IN ('SYNC_TEXT','SYNC_IMAGE','SYNC_AUDIO','SUBMITTING') AND p.lease_until IS NOT NULL AND p.lease_until > NOW(3)) AND r.status IN ('PENDING','CLAIMED','UNSUPPORTED') AND e.verdict IN ('UNKNOWN','UNSUPPORTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END uncertain FROM aid_media_execution_permit p LEFT JOIN aid_media_task t ON t.id=p.task_id LEFT JOIN aid_media_submission_reconciliation r ON r.task_id=p.task_id AND r.del_flag='0' LEFT JOIN aid_media_submission_evidence e ON e.id=r.last_evidence_id AND e.task_id=p.task_id AND e.reconciliation_id=r.id AND e.del_flag='0' WHERE p.state IN ('RESERVED','ACTIVE') ) admissions
mapper.update: UPDATE aid_media_execution_permit SET state='ACTIVE',execution_mode=#{executionMode}, lease_until=CASE WHEN #{executionMode} IN ('SYNC_TEXT','SYNC_IMAGE','SYNC_AUDIO','SUBMITTING') THEN TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{leaseSeconds},NOW(3)) ELSE NULL END,update_time=NOW(3) WHERE token=#{token} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} AND state='RESERVED' AND execution_mode='RESERVED' AND lease_until > NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT token FROM aid_media_execution_permit WHERE active_task_id=#{taskId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aid_media_execution_permit WHERE token=#{token} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} AND state='ACTIVE' AND (execution_mode='ASYNC' OR (execution_mode IN ('SYNC_TEXT','SYNC_IMAGE','SYNC_AUDIO','SUBMITTING') AND lease_until > NOW(3)))
mapper.update: UPDATE aid_media_execution_permit SET lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{leaseSeconds},NOW(3)),update_time=NOW(3) WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND state='ACTIVE' AND execution_mode IN ('SYNC_TEXT','SYNC_IMAGE','SYNC_AUDIO','SUBMITTING') AND lease_until > NOW(3) AND token IN #{token}
UPDATE aid_media_execution_permit SET state='RELEASED',release_reason=#{reason},released_at=NOW(3),update_time=NOW(3) WHERE token=#{token} AND state IN ('RESERVED','ACTIVE')

UPDATE aid_media_execution_permit p JOIN aid_media_task t ON t.id=p.task_id AND t.execution_permit_token=p.token SET p.state='RELEASED',p.execution_mode=#{executionMode}, p.release_reason='LOCAL_SYNC_RESPONSE_COMPLETED',p.released_at=NOW(3),p.update_time=NOW(3) WHERE p.token=#{token} AND p.task_id=#{taskId} AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND p.execution_mode='ASYNC' AND t.status='PENDING' AND (t.provider_task_id IS NULL OR t.provider_task_id='') AND ((t.media_type='TEXT' AND #{executionMode}='SYNC_TEXT') OR (t.media_type='IMAGE' AND #{executionMode}='SYNC_IMAGE') OR (t.media_type='AUDIO' AND #{executionMode}='SYNC_AUDIO'))
mapper.select: SELECT model_code,COUNT(*) active_count FROM aid_media_execution_permit WHERE state IN ('RESERVED','ACTIVE') AND model_code IN #{code} GROUP BY model_code
SELECT provider_id,COUNT(*) active_count FROM aid_media_execution_permit WHERE state IN ('RESERVED','ACTIVE') AND provider_id IN #{id} GROUP BY provider_id
